# Characterization summary

<!-- GENERATED by characterization/gen_summary.py from characterization/sources.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This file collects the numerical bounds that the committed `sim/` records support, with
the conditions under which each holds. Every min/max below is recomputed from the cited
CSV/JSON by `gen_summary.py`; CI fails if a source changed, a bound moved, or this file
is stale. It runs no simulation.

It is a statement of measured evidence only. There is **no ratified spec** (see gaps),
so there is deliberately no pass/fail-versus-spec column, and no target is derived from
any measurement here. `non-numeric` counts cells such as `NA` that are excluded from
the min/max.
